title: MetricSnapshot
description: Per-sprint KPI capture for the 3APK pilot. One row per sprint in the Notion Metrics database. Fields align with PRD success metrics: EAR, DoR pass rate, planning minutes, reopen count, and team confidence.

sprint_id.description: Foreign key to the Sprint this snapshot belongs to.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this snapshot was captured (end of sprint).

story_count.description: Number of stories committed to the sprint. Required for rate calculations.

ear.description: Estimation Accuracy Ratio: Sum(actual hours) / Sum(estimated hours). Target range: 0.85–1.15. Lower values indicate over-estimation; higher values indicate under-estimation.

dor_pass_rate.description: Definition of Ready pass rate as a fraction (0.0–1.0). Calculated as DoR-passed stories / total planned stories. Target: ≥0.80.

planning_minutes.description: Total planning + refinement time in minutes (participant-minutes = duration × number of participants). Baseline comparison target: −30% reduction vs. baseline sprint.

reopen_count.description: Number of stories moved back (reopened) during the sprint due to scope gaps or missing acceptance criteria. Target: −25% vs. baseline.

confidence_score.description: Team planning confidence score (1.0–5.0 scale) from anonymous post-sprint survey. Target: ≥4.0.

notes.description: Facilitator observation notes for this sprint (qualitative context for PEX report).

phase.description: Pilot phase label for grouping snapshots in dashboard views.
